item.title: View Resource Quotas
item.description: This section describes how to view the resource quotas for the current KubeSphere version. When the amount of used resources reaches the quota limit, the corresponding resources cannot be created. Prerequisites You need to have the Platform Settings Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Platform Settings Management permissions.
